title: Kenyan Tripe Stew
description: A flavorful and nutritious stew originating from Kenya, made with tripe and a variety of spices.

ingredients.name: Kenyan spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most African or international grocery stores

ingredients.name: Resinous garlic
ingredients.notes: mince the garlic and sauté until fragrant

instructions: Heat the beef broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the tripe and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the Kenyan spice blend, salt, and black pepper, and cook for another minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes and water, and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1.5 hours, or until the tripe is tender.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
